synopsis.native: Trop longtemps séparée de son frère, Alice se rend sur ses traces au Japon, dans un village hors du temps, au pied des falaises. Ici, Nathan avait retrouvé l'apaisement auprès d'un certain Daïsuke. C'est au tour d'Alice de se rapprocher du vieil homme, et de ses hôtes. Dans une atmosphère toute japonaise, elle se remet à écouter son coeur...
synopsis.english: Alice has been separated from her brother, Nathan, for too long. After he dies, Alice leaves for Japan and finds refuge in a small village by the cliffs. Nathan said he had found peace there, thanks to a man called Daisuke. As she follows in her brother’s footsteps, she too becomes close with the elderly man and with his other guests. In a particularly Japanese atmosphere, she starts to listen to her own heart once again.
